

## Battery Example: Calculating a CI

- Sample size: \( n = 100 \)
- Sample mean: \( \bar{x} = 57.4 \) hours
- Sample standard deviation: \( s = 15.1 \)
- Confidence level: 95%
- Since \( n = 100 \), use normal distribution → \( Z = 1.96 \)

### Calculation:
\[
SE = \frac{15.1}{\sqrt{100}} = 1.51
\]
\[
CI = 57.4 \pm (1.96 \cdot 1.51) = (54.44,\ 60.36)
\]
